s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal viral and rheumatologic panels
normal chest radiograph and high-resolution chest CT scan
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showing nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showing nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions with systemic symptoms, and presence of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions with systemic symptoms, and presence of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms, and presence of atypical lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions and inflammatory arthritis, although less likely given the presence of atypical lymphocytes

raw.rationale: The presence of dermal papules, nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Lymphomatoid papulosis typically presents with self-healing papules and a lack of systemic symptoms, which is not consistent with the patient's presentation

rejected.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This condition typically involves subcutaneous fat and presents with panniculitis, which is not described in the patient's presentation

rejected.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with systemic symptoms such as fever, night sweats, and weight loss, as well as lymphadenopathy, which is not present in this patient

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Dermatomyositis typically presents with muscle weakness and characteristic skin findings such as Gottron's papules, which are not described in the patient's presentation
